chooser.title: Vent-Clip Figures ($19) — Best for Character & Simplicity
chooser.body: Astronaut, Bear, Guitar, and Pear figures clip onto any air vent. Waterless felt/oil core, refillable in seconds. The most affordable entry point — and genuinely display-worthy on your dash.

chooser.title: Machined Metal Disc ($34) — Best for a Minimal, Grown-Up Look
chooser.body: Solid machined metal with a magnetic snap top. No novelty shape — just a sleek two-piece disc that clips to your vent and arrives gift-boxed. Waterless refillable felt pad.

chooser.title: Pulse Smart Spray ($39) — Best for Hands-Free Timed Scenting
chooser.body: The only model that sprays on its own. Set a mist timer, choose one of three intensity levels, and let it run. Ambient light ring for night drives. USB-C rechargeable.

chooser.title: Rechargeable Waterless Diffuser ($39) — Best Vent-Free Placement
chooser.body: USB-C rechargeable and vent-independent — sits upright anywhere in the cabin without clipping to an air vent. Adjustable output, no water tank, no spills.

chooser.title: Aviator Bear Spinning Propeller ($19) — Best for a Bit of Motion
chooser.body: The propeller actually spins on your vent's airflow, fanning scent evenly through the cabin. Soft-touch silicone clip, magnetic top for mess-free refills, waterless core.

chooser.title: Guitar Swaying Figure ($19) — Best for Music Lovers
chooser.body: Sways gently with airflow on a 360° rotating silicone clip. Waterless refillable scent core, works on any air vent. A quiet, movement-based detail for the dash.

faqs.question: Do I need a subscription for a car diffuser?
faqs.answer: Not with Autivara. Every model is a one-time purchase — you fill it with any essential or fragrance oil you already own, and refill it whenever you like. There is no subscription, no proprietary vial system, and no recurring charge required to keep using it.

faqs.question: Which Autivara car diffuser lasts longest?
faqs.answer: All Autivara car diffusers are refillable indefinitely, so the diffuser itself doesn't expire. Scent longevity between refills depends on the oil you use and the output setting you choose. The Rechargeable Car Diffuser ($39) and the Pulse Smart Spray ($39) both have adjustable output modes that let you stretch each fill further by starting at the lowest setting and increasing only as needed.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a waterless car diffuser and a regular car air freshener?
faqs.answer: A traditional disposable air freshener (hanging card, gel vent clip, or plastic unit) has a fixed fragrance baked in — once it fades in 2–4 weeks, you throw it away and buy another. A waterless car diffuser like Autivara's uses a dry felt pad or scent core that you recharge with a few drops of any oil. You choose the scent, control the intensity, and reuse the same unit indefinitely — no single-use plastic waste, no locked-in fragrance, no subscription.

/industrial.heading: Commercial Scent Diffusers — Own Your Oil, No Contract Required
/industrial.intro: Professional scenting shouldn't mean locking your business into a proprietary refill contract. Unlike ScentAir or Aroma360 — whose systems tie you to their branded oils at their prices — every Autivara commercial diffuser works with any fragrance oil you choose. Buy the hardware once, fill it with what you want, and own the experience from day one. Three units cover the full range of commercial spaces, from a single boutique room to an entire venue scented through your existing HVAC ductwork.

chooser.title: Small office, boutique, or guest suite
chooser.body: The Smart Plug-In ($79) slots into any wall outlet — no mounting hardware, no wiring. Wi-Fi scheduling and a magnetic snap-in refill have your space scenting in minutes. Ideal for up to ~500 sq ft.

chooser.title: Restaurant, salon, or dental waiting room
chooser.body: The Atmos Wi-Fi ($149) wall-mounts cleanly in a lobby or treatment corridor and covers ~1,000 sq ft with waterless nebulized scent. App scheduling lets you dial intensity up for busy service hours and down overnight — no staff intervention needed.

chooser.title: Retail floor or mid-size showroom
chooser.body: The Atmos Wi-Fi ($149) covers a mid-size showroom or retail floor at ~1,000 sq ft. Its magnetic refill bay means oil swaps happen in seconds — useful when you rotate seasonal fragrances to match promotions.

chooser.title: Whole hotel, venue, or multi-room facility
chooser.body: The Atmos Pro HVAC ($349) connects directly to your building's existing ductwork and delivers consistent scent to every room through the vents already installed. One machine, one schedule, whole-venue coverage at 2,000+ sq ft.

chooser.title: Spa or wellness studio
chooser.body: The Atmos Wi-Fi ($149) handles a mid-size treatment floor at ~1,000 sq ft. Waterless nebulizing means pure oil only — no water, no heat — keeping the scent clean and consistent across treatment rooms.

chooser.title: Large venue needing HVAC integration
chooser.body: The Atmos Pro HVAC ($349) is the top of the Autivara commercial range. It ties into your existing ductwork so a single machine scents an entire venue evenly — with minute-level app scheduling for intensity and run times.

faqs.question: Do commercial scent diffusers require a contract?
faqs.answer: Autivara commercial diffusers require no contract of any kind. Some competing services (such as subscription-based scenting companies) require ongoing service agreements that tie you to their proprietary refill oils. Autivara hardware is a one-time purchase and works with any fragrance oil you choose — there are no recurring service fees, no locked refills, and no minimum commitment.

faqs.question: How much does commercial scenting cost per month?
faqs.answer: With Autivara, your only recurring cost is the fragrance oil you choose to use — there is no monthly service fee or subscription. Hardware costs range from $79 (Smart Plug-In) to $149 (Atmos Wi-Fi) to $349 (Atmos Pro HVAC), each a one-time purchase. Because the diffusers are compatible with any oil, you control your ongoing cost entirely.

faqs.question: What is the coverage area of an HVAC scent diffuser?
faqs.answer: The Atmos Pro HVAC is designed for whole-venue coverage and handles 2,000+ sq ft by connecting to your building's existing HVAC ductwork. Scent is distributed evenly through the vents already in place, so a single unit can cover multiple rooms or floors. For smaller spaces, the wall-mounted Atmos Wi-Fi covers ~1,000 sq ft and the Smart Plug-In covers ~500 sq ft.

faqs.question: Which commercial diffuser is right for a restaurant, salon, or dental office?
faqs.answer: For most single-floor service businesses — restaurants, salons, spas, and dental waiting areas — the Atmos Wi-Fi ($149) is the practical fit. It wall-mounts discreetly, covers ~1,000 sq ft with app-scheduled waterless scent, and swaps oils in seconds via its magnetic refill bay. For a larger multi-room venue, step up to the Atmos Pro HVAC ($349), which ties into existing ductwork for 2,000+ sq ft of even coverage.
